subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should OpenClaw expose deterministic announce suppression as a per-spawn-only control, or also add a persistent `agents.defaults.subagents` default?
rationale: Both surfaces are public compatibility contracts: the per-spawn control is narrowly scoped, while a persistent default affects existing operational expectations and configuration support. The current issue and related routing work do not establish which contract maintainers want to own.

options.title: Per-spawn `skip` first
options.body: Add a narrow `sessions_spawn` announce-mode override whose default preserves current delivery behavior, then evaluate persistent policy from real usage.

options.title: Add spawn override and persistent default
options.body: Support both a per-spawn override and a documented sub-agent default, with the default retaining current model-driven delivery semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader routing design
options.body: Defer this issue until the maintainers choose a unified delivery-target model that includes skip and parent-session routing.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn `skip` first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `sessions_spawn` announce-mode override whose default preserves current delivery behavior, then evaluate persistent policy from real usage.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties the central spawn and announce-delivery behavior to this area, making Peter the strongest available routing candidate for the public-contract choice.
